name: Institutional resistance

subjectOf.text: Incumbent institutions deploy decentralization neutralizers, defined as mechanisms that preserve institutional relevance by blocking technologies that threaten to replace them, yet institutional replacement is inexorable once technology enables superior coordination.
subjectOf.abstract: Incumbent institutions deploy what I have termed "decentralization neutralizers," mechanisms that preserve institutional relevance by blocking technologies that threaten to replace them.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Collapse of Scarcity Economics (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6421319

subjectOf.text: The legal profession faces a structural problem that incremental reform cannot solve, because its obsolescence curve is steeper than the curriculum adaptation curve.
subjectOf.abstract: The profession's obsolescence curve is steeper than the curriculum's adaptation curve. A structural problem that incremental reform cannot solve.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Collapse of Scarcity Economics (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6421319
scope_conditions: applies to the legal profession and legal education
